master.description: This lightweight silk/cotton tunic-style top doubles as the perfect swim cover up.
master.features:
• Cotton/Silk
  • Super lightweight, soft, comfortable
  • Machine wash and lay flat to dry
master.name: Soleil Tunic
master.reviews:
By firedupps from nashville,tn
This runs a little big I think, got the medium the first time and it kind of hung off on the shoulders a bit so I exchanged it for a small and it is perfect. This is the coolest looking top with leggings! I want to get another one! Also it washed really well, stayed true to size but I did let it air dry.
By Trixien from West Michigan This tunic is made of very soft material and it looks cute on. I expected it to be a little thicker, but it is okay. I ordered an XS (5'3 and 108 lbs).
